_comment: Provenance for the vendored block-palette dumps this directory holds. Each entry names the exact upstream release the file was pulled from, byte-for-byte, so the chain back to the game stays auditable (architecture decision 12). Re-pin by re-running the fetch against the named tag and checking the sha256 still matches what upstream serves -- a mismatch means the tag was force-moved upstream, which is worth investigating rather than silently accepting.

entries.note: Earliest tag that carries metadata/vanilladata_modules at all -- see COVERAGE.md.
Byte-identical to v1.26.0.2's dump -- no block-palette change shipped between them despite the version-number jump.
Byte-identical to v1.21.130.3's dump -- see above.
Latest stable tag when this entry was pinned (2026-08-17); byte-identical to the repository's main branch at the same date.
Latest stable tag as of 2026-11-27. The v1.26.70.* tags are previews and are not pinned.

coverage_note: This is a representative subset of the stable (non -preview) tags that carry the dump, not the full ladder. bedrock-samples has published the dump on every stable tag from v1.20.10.1 through the current release (28 stable tags as surveyed on the pin date); adding the rest is a matter of extending this manifest with the same fields and re-running `cargo xtask generate-palette` -- the generator does not special-case which versions are present.
biome_comment: Provenance for the vendored biome dumps, surveyed separately from the block dumps above because their coverage differs: `mojang-biomes.json` does not exist at all at v1.20.10.1 (first appears at v1.21.0.3), and even once present it carries no numeric `id` field until v1.21.130.3 -- confirmed directly against the upstream tag trees on the survey date below, not assumed. Only the tags that carry a numeric id are pinned here, since a name-only dump cannot answer the id-to-name lookup `ContentProvider::biome_name` needs. Re-pin the same way as the block entries: re-fetch the named tag and confirm the sha256 still matches.
biome_survey_note: Surveyed all six block-dump tags via the GitHub API tree listing for metadata/vanilladata_modules at each tag. v1.20.10.1: no mojang-biomes.json at all. v1.21.0.3 and v1.21.60.10: mojang-biomes.json present but every data_items entry is name-only, no id field. v1.21.130.3, v1.26.0.2, v1.26.40.05: every entry carries a numeric id alongside the name. v1.21.130.3 and v1.26.0.2 are byte-identical (same as the block dumps at those two tags) -- no biome-table change shipped between them either.

biome_entries.note: Earliest tag whose biome dump carries a numeric id. Byte-identical to v1.26.0.2's dump.
Byte-identical to v1.21.130.3's dump -- see above.
Adds several biome ids beyond v1.26.0.2 (89 entries vs. 87).
